title: Pi
summary: the Pi coding agent (pi.dev) driven by agentd's built-in adapter. The vendor's CLI is installed separately.
description: A first-party descriptor of one of agentd's built-in harness adapters (design 73 section 8, D1464). The listing describes Loams' adapter, which is Apache-2.0 and ships inside loams-agentd; the vendor's CLI is installed separately (Settings can run the vendor's official installer) and found on PATH or through its `*_EXECUTABLE` override. The vendor's software is separate, under its own licence and terms. agentd launches it as `pi --mode rpc --no-themes` and drives its JSONL RPC protocol; Pi 0.85.1 or newer is required.
